name: Naija City Fictional Lagos — district asset library
styleTarget: low-poly semi-realism: restrained stylization, realistic scale, PBR-compatible lighting/material treatment, authentic district composition
runtimePolicy: Library-only. Models are not automatically loaded or placed into the live world. Stream only assets required by a nearby district and reuse shared models as instances.

Lekki.visualIdentity: Coastal barrier-peninsula growth: expressway spine, planned gated estates, apartment clusters and a changing edge of informal roadside commerce and service yards.
streetAndEnvironment: estate entrance gates and boundary walls
palms, wetland-edge shrubs and scattered trees
needsCustom: Lekki-specific gated estate entrance and security lodge
Nigerian roadside kiosk and repair-yard kit
lagoon / wetland edge and drainage detail
distinctive Lagos signboards and frontage graphics

Ekiti.visualIdentity: Green upland towns with undulating slopes, isolated or clustered steep-sided dome rocks and ridges; compact compounds sit within a lush, hilly landscape.
streetAndEnvironment: broadleaf trees, palms, bushes and dense green cover
needsCustom: Ekiti / Yoruba courtyard-compound house modules
laterite and earth-block facade material set
stone retaining edge and slope-road segments
Efon-Alaaye-inspired large dome-rock formations

Eko Atlantic.visualIdentity: Planned reclaimed coastal city: flat graded ground, clear street hierarchy, broad boulevards, mixed-use towers, marina / canal edges and a major rock-armoured sea defence.
streetAndEnvironment: sea wall promenade and rock revetment
needsCustom: rock revetment / sea-wall segment kit
canal quay walls and pedestrian bridge set
glass / stone curtain-wall materials
marina furniture and waterfront promenade props

Victoria Island.visualIdentity: Dense commercial and hospitality centre mixed with serviced-apartment towers, older family compounds, leafy side streets, plazas and high-residential corridors.
buildingMix: older detached homes and mixed-use conversions
streetAndEnvironment: commercial plazas and covered retail frontages
streetlights, signs, sidewalks and planted public spaces
needsCustom: recognizable Lagos hotel / office facade variants without copying protected logos
VI-style entrance plazas and retail canopies
distinctive glass curtain-wall and stone-cladding materials

Yaba.visualIdentity: Layered mainland streets: older Afro-Brazilian / colonial-era bungalows alongside 3–4-storey tenements, shopfronts, newer offices, schools and compact backstreets.
streetAndEnvironment: mixed building setbacks and compound gates
courtyard greens and occasional market spaces
needsCustom: Afro-Brazilian / colonial bungalow facade kit
Lagos tenement balcony / corridor facade kit
Yaba market stall and signage family
roadside drainage and patched asphalt detailing

Alimosho.visualIdentity: Large residential district with low- and medium-density neighbourhoods, local commercial nodes, busy roundabouts, markets, transport terminals and expressway-front mixed use.
streetAndEnvironment: overhead utility infrastructure and street trees
needsCustom: busy open-market stall rows and lock-up shop modules
Lagos bus stop / BRT terminal scenery
Nigerian compound gate and wall variants
local shop signs and roadside vending props
